name: Rive
tagline: Rive is a real-time interactive animation platform where designers create animations that respond to game state, user input, and data — not just play back a fixed sequence. Its runtime is lightweight enough to run in a browser, iOS app, or game engine without performance costs. UI engineers and game developers use Rive to add state-machine-driven animations that make interfaces feel genuinely alive.
